note: Provider DEFINITIONS for large payload/wordlist repositories. These are NOT ingested blindly. Payload knowledge is separated from ordinary explanatory knowledge and carries high-risk metadata. Oyster indexes only the CATALOGUE/file metadata so it can recommend the correct list to an APPROVED tool — it does not embed millions of raw entries, and it never auto-executes a payload.

items.name: PayloadsAllTheThings
items.purpose: Reference collection of payloads and bypass techniques per vulnerability class.
items.licence: See upstream (mixed / MIT-style) — confirm before reuse.

items.name: SecLists
items.purpose: Collection of wordlists for discovery, fuzzing, and password testing.
items.guidance: Recommend the correct list (e.g. Discovery/Web-Content/common.txt for content discovery, a specific rockyou-derived list for password tests) to an approved tool; do not embed the list contents into retrieval.
